name: ChordRes from rest, without attention value embeddings
tagline: Scalar ChordRes with input smear and context-projected values.
description: The saved-force ChordRes backbone retains its layer sizes and gated input smear. The alternating attention value lookup tables and the associated VE gates are removed.
mechanism: Unit-RMS hidden state and a per-token tangent velocity
Independent scalar controls for each attention and FFN site
BF16 force tensors retained on the GPU for the fused Chord backward
limitations: The reduction in lookup capacity is part of this ablation. The trial is a native-shell model with smear.
